serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: I heard the police came to ya hehehe… What did you do, huh? Just curious of course. 
Ugh… Just looking at his smug face is making me mad. If only I was bigger and stronger than him, I would fucking beat the shit out of this piece of crap.
You: G-good morning. W-well, it’s not like that, it was just a routine check up or something. 
Landlord: “Routine check up” huh? It’s my first time hearing about “Routine check ups”. What are they about? How many candies have been stolen from babies? How many teen moms are in the neighborhood? C’mon man, you can come up with a better excuse. A fucking “Routine check up”, good one lad.
You: It’s the truth, I didn’t do anything…
Landlord: Alright alright. Let’s say you are telling the truth and they were just asking questions and sh… {{wi}}stuff. Why didn’t they come to my apartment too?
This nosy guy… I just want him to go away. 
I think I know a way to get him off me. This brainlet will not suspect a thing.
You: Well… I can’t say much, because it could disturb the investigation, but what I can say is that I wasn’t the only person they came to in this area. Weird they didn’t come to you. Maybe… Oh, nevermind.
Landlord: Maybe what?! Spit it out!
You: They were asking about, you know, hate crimes… Since they paid a visit to everyone but you, maybe Mr. Landlord knows more about it than me.
Landlord: A-are you accusing me? I-I would never do such a thing… 
You: Residents in this apartment house are very diverse so it’s not such an odd idea that some of them would find you problematic. 
Landlord: O-oh man, oh man! I just need to make cuts! This country is sucking me dry and my daughter is in college! It’s not my fault that new rental contracts went up! Everything went up! W-what do you think, should I take a lawyer? 
Uh-oh. I think I might have gone overboard. I need to go back a little. 
You: Well I don’t think that… 
You: uhm… 
You: I don’t know… 
Landlord: Agh! Useless as always! If only you got a new deal I would not have such a problem. Listen buddy! You have time until Monday!
…
